personalize.question: How do I personalize the collar?
personalize.answer: Click the first empty slot next to "1. Enter letters" and just start typing on your keyboard — the chosen letter appears instantly in the selected slot, and the next slot automatically becomes active so you can keep typing. This lets you preview in advance how your dog's name or message will look on the collar.

editLetter.question: How do I change a letter?
editLetter.answer: Click the slot you want to change and type a new letter — it will replace the previous one.

letterCount.question: How many letters can I add?
letterCount.answer: You can fill up to 6 slots. 5 charms are included in the collar price, and each additional one costs €3.99.

color.question: How do I choose a color?
color.answer: Select an already-entered letter, then choose the color you want from the options below.

size.question: How do I choose the right size?
size.answer: Next to the size selection, click the "How to measure the right size" button.

sizeGuide.title: How to measure your dog
steps: Wrap a soft measuring tape around the middle of your dog's neck, where a collar would normally sit.
The tape should sit snugly but not tight. Two fingers should fit between the tape and the neck.
If the measurement falls between sizes, choose the larger one for everyday comfort.
sizeGuide.tip: Tip: Measure at the end of the day when your dog is relaxed. If the coat is fluffy, measure underneath it, not over it.

waterproof.question: Are PawCharms collars waterproof?
waterproof.answer: Yes. All PawCharms collars are made from food-grade silicone, so they're fully waterproof and safe for swimming, rain, and muddy walks. The material doesn't absorb odors or stains.

charms.question: How do the interchangeable charms work?
charms.answer: Each charm has a snap-on connector that attaches and detaches in about 5 seconds. No tools, no hassle. Freely mix and match all 12 designs across different collars.

sizing.question: How do I choose the right collar size?
sizing.answer: Measure the widest part of your dog's neck and add 2-3 cm for comfort. S fits 28-36 cm, M fits 36-44 cm, and L fits 44-52 cm.

engraving.question: Can I engrave my dog's name on the collar?
engraving.answer: Yes - personalized engraving is available at checkout. You can add your dog's name, a short message, or a phone number for safety.

manufacturing.question: Where are PawCharms collars made?
manufacturing.answer: Every collar is designed and handmade in Vilnius, Lithuania. We're a small team, so every order is prepared with great care.
